_about: Narration for the Storyraise Personalization walkthrough (approved by Vince 2026-10-28). `text` is what viewers read in captions; [[cue:name]] markers are stripped before TTS and become timestamps visuals land on. `respell` maps a caption word to how the voice should say it (applied to the TTS text only). Labels match the product UI (public/index.html, public/builder/index.html, public/preview/index.html). American English, no em dashes. Value first: caveats (a plain link without ?for= shows every Show When block; only Mailchimp has a built-in merge tag) live in the page FAQ and KB, not here.

scenes.title: Cold open
scenes.text: One report, [[cue:many]]written for every donor. [[cue:brand]]With Storyraise personalization, each reader sees their own name, their own giving, and the story that fits them.

scenes.title: Add constituents
scenes.text: It starts on the [[cue:tab]]Constituents tab. [[cue:add]]Choose Add constituents, then [[cue:csv]]upload a CSV file, [[cue:crm]]or connect your CRM so your records stay in sync.

scenes.title: CSV columns
scenes.text: [[cue:required]]Your file needs First Name, Last Name, and Email. [[cue:custom]]Every other column, like Donor Level or Gift Amount, comes in as a custom field. [[cue:map]]Map your columns, [[cue:import]]then Import constituents.

scenes.title: Constituent profile
scenes.text: [[cue:open]]Open anyone to see their profile. [[cue:table]]Each field is a variable, [[cue:tag]]like donor level, ready to drop into a report.

scenes.title: Merge fields
scenes.text: [[cue:canvas]]In the report, type a variable right into your text, [[cue:prepared]]between double at signs. [[cue:becomes]]Dear first name becomes Dear Emily, with her own gift and giving level filled in too.

scenes.title: Show When
scenes.text: [[cue:select]]To show a section to some donors only, select it and open Use Data. [[cue:showwhen]]Under Show When, [[cue:variable]]pick donor level, [[cue:condition]]is, [[cue:value]]Gold. [[cue:levels]]Silver and Bronze get their own sections, set up the same way.

scenes.title: Preview as a donor
scenes.text: [[cue:preview]]Open web preview and choose who you are previewing as. [[cue:emily]]Emily Wilson is a Bronze donor, [[cue:emilystory]]so she sees her name and the Bronze story. [[cue:james]]Switch to James Taylor, [[cue:jamesstory]]and the same report turns Gold.

scenes.title: Personalized link
scenes.text: [[cue:share]]Ready to send? Publish your report, then open Share. [[cue:platform]]Tell us which email platform you use, [[cue:getlink]]and Get report link. [[cue:link]]Your platform fills in each donor's email, so everyone opens their own report.

scenes.title: Send it with Storyraise
scenes.text: [[cue:sendcard]]Or let us send it for you. [[cue:draft]]Storyraise Send drafts the email, with a personalized View the Report button. [[cue:steps]]Pick your recipients, like the donors you just imported, then schedule it and send.

scenes.title: Close
scenes.text: [[cue:recap]]Upload your donors, add a few variables, and every reader gets a report that feels written for them.
